sow_rows.original_item: perform changes on software as per client policies and requirements.
sow_rows.baseline_implemented_evidence: Typed settings, policy publication, attendance and leave rules exist.
sow_rows.baseline_remaining_scope: Complete payroll/lifecycle policy execution and signed policy settings. Broad SOW promise is not fully met.

reviewed_findings.title: Payroll attendance SQL is incompatible and day arithmetic is unsafe
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Use work_date plus paid leave/weekoff predicates, SUM weighted days, require complete locked inputs and retain true zero payable days. Integration-test P/HD/LWP/paid-WO/all-absent cases.

reviewed_findings.title: Mid-month salary assignments can be skipped silently
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Resolve approved effective salary segments through the covered period and derive payable tenure from joining/leaving dates. Fail an incomplete run with explicit missing-salary exceptions.

reviewed_findings.title: Real payroll never supplies required statutory and debt facts
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Freeze and pass authoritative effective policy, membership, tax/YTD and debt facts; call the same tested statutory engines used by previews. Prove end-to-end run goldens including mid-period ESIC increase, apprentice and existing loan.

reviewed_findings.title: Recovery inputs print but do not reduce net pay
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Classify input and arrear effects by component kind, validate allowed amounts and update earning/deduction/employer bases consistently. Add an independent full-run recovery fixture.

reviewed_findings.title: Detected OT is paid without approval and uses an absent component
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Consume only approved unconsumed OT against locked inputs; prohibit CO double consumption and bind the approved canonical component/policy base.

reviewed_findings.title: Arrears can be paid again on subsequent runs
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Reserve/consume each signed delta exactly once in the same financial transaction; preserve original/result versions and retry-safe keys.

reviewed_findings.title: Finalization ignores line and review reconciliation failures
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Independently reconcile signed component classes, per-item and full-register totals, expected population and approved review exceptions; require the complete reconciled gate under a transaction/row lock.

reviewed_findings.title: Closed payroll results remain editable
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Protect insert/update/delete of all frozen facts/results using DB constraints/triggers and grants. Retro creates new versions and current-period deltas; preserve original closed results.

reviewed_findings.title: Maker/checker validation fails open on missing evidence
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Persist authoritative maker/checker records with separate DB-backed authorities, reject missing evidence, and atomically enforce legal transitions/audit/reconciliation.

reviewed_findings.title: New API routes disagree with product callers
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Generate and use the OpenAPI client, define explicit matching routes without a duplicate prefix, align input/output contracts and authenticated transport; test real browser->API flows.

reviewed_findings.title: Payroll UI simulates successful computation and payment facts
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Read authoritative runs/results, persist actions through protected API, surface pending/error states and download actual generated artifacts. Keep fixture demos outside product routes.

reviewed_findings.title: F&F substitutes fixture salary, leave and payable days
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Require authoritative as-of salary, attendance, leave ledger, paid holds, debt and final tax inputs. Fail missing facts explicitly; retain frozen calculation provenance and reviewed overrides.

reviewed_findings.title: F&F can mark paid and issue letters without approval/payment
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Implement approved immutable settlement->payment obligation->verified receipt transitions, with maker/checker, idempotency, audit/outbox and atomic exit/letter release. Do not label queued payouts paid.

reviewed_findings.title: Onboarding conversion is not atomic and creates unusable salary/login
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Use the existing validated employee/e-code/salary/auth public APIs inside one owned transaction. Resolve mandatory master links and actual salary breakup, candidate consumption key, welcome credentials/grants and outbox tasks.

reviewed_findings.title: Probation confirmation leaves a salary gap and zero components
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Close the prior interval at confirmation date, resolve actual approved salary amounts, make decision/salary/employee/letter effects atomic and idempotent, and connect non-confirmation separation.

reviewed_findings.title: Future transfers mutate today and promotions do not change salary
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Publish effective-dated placement/salary changes; activate projections on effective date with validated aligned links, historical scope snapshots and signed leave/entity payroll continuity.

reviewed_findings.title: Year-end claim taxable recovery counts unrelated bills repeatedly
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Query each approved taxable bucket/FY and verified line amount exactly once; distinguish unclaimed from unsubstantiated policy and post one idempotent final-FY tax adjustment.

reviewed_findings.title: Parallel-run gate can pass with missing population or component errors
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Compare the union of both employee/component populations, reject empty/mismatched inputs, and require approved tolerances, explained dispositions and persisted two-cycle human sign-offs.

reviewed_findings.title: Opening YTD financial facts exist only in process memory
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Persist immutable reviewed imports/mappings/opening postings with source checksum, employee/FY validation and replay keys; feed the exact facts into payroll snapshots.

reviewed_findings.title: Apply-increment reports success without salary revisions
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Resolve approved employee salary facts server-side, atomically create real effective revisions and replay-safe recompute/delta obligations, and return actual persisted counts.

reviewed_findings.title: Output readiness and artifact ownership are inferred incorrectly
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Persist versioned per-run/payer artifacts with checksum, complete population and actual generation receipts; expose availability from those records, not approval state.

reviewed_findings.title: SAP mapping loses legal payer and cost-center dimensions
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Use the approved scoped GL mapping keys from the canonical table, fail missing/ambiguous mappings and reconcile exact balanced amounts from frozen placement/result versions.

reviewed_findings.title: Income-tax seed contradicts its cited reference and FY claim
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Resolve D01 with signed authoritative notification/FY evidence; keep one effective-dated statutory policy source shared by real payroll and previews, with independent goldens and explicit unsupported-FY failures.

reviewed_findings.title: Salary assignment and payroll disagree on paise versus rupee units
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Use an explicit integer-paise salary snapshot boundary everywhere; inspect existing snapshots for import provenance without guessing their unit. Correct F&F consumers and prove assignment-to-run and assignment-to-F&F integration. Run boundary fixed with regression; remaining consumers and legacy-data provenance remain open.

reviewed_findings.title: Salary preview and assignment ignore configured amount rules
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
repair_evidence: structure.service.ts assembleComponentNodes; salary.service.ts assignSalary; structure.router.ts accepts amount_rule
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Define and validate the documented amount_rule grammar and CTC anchors; use one assembler for preview and assignment. Reject missing rules rather than fabricate pay. Add real persisted-structure preview/assignment tests with explicit approved amounts.

reviewed_findings.title: Probation scales earnings after dependent contributions have already been computed
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
repair_evidence: Source ordering in resolveSalaryStructure; existing G6 test omits deduction/employer nodes
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Apply approved probation scaling before evaluating dependent deduction/employer formulas and balancing CTC. Add a hand-computed fixture that includes BASIC, PF_EE and employer PF, with approved rounding and policy inputs.

reviewed_findings.title: Configured PT slabs are accepted by the compute interface but never used
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
repair_evidence: Compute input declaration and computePt call; statutory/pt.ts uses built-in WB table only
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Pass authoritative effective-dated slab facts to the shared PT engine, reject missing applicable state policy, and test custom configured slabs through the run path. Do not infer current statutory rates from this defect review.

reviewed_findings.title: Parallel comparison drops repeated lines of the same component
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Sum all signed component facts in integer paise per employee/component. Corrected shared component aggregation is now used by the real comparison; durable complete-population two-cycle/sign-off gates remain open under R29.

reviewed_findings.title: Numeric SOW citations in phase plans and backend comments do not identify the original requirements
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Regenerate phase tables from the exact original crosswalk, preserve requirement IDs, and replace unverified numeric references in backend comments. Done for backend comments and Phase2/3 maps; source-doc section labels and remaining frontend annotations require separate context validation.

reviewed_findings.required_repair: Protect insert/update/delete of all frozen facts/results using DB constraints/triggers and grants. Retro creates new versions and current-period deltas; preserve original closed results.

reviewed_findings.title: Maker/checker validation fails open on missing evidence
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Persist authoritative maker/checker records with separate DB-backed authorities, reject missing evidence, and atomically enforce legal transitions/audit/reconciliation.

reviewed_findings.title: New API routes disagree with product callers
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Generate and use the OpenAPI client, define explicit matching routes without a duplicate prefix, align input/output contracts and authenticated transport; test real browser->API flows.

reviewed_findings.title: Payroll UI simulates successful computation and payment facts
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Read authoritative runs/results, persist actions through protected API, surface pending/error states and download actual generated artifacts. Keep fixture demos outside product routes.

reviewed_findings.title: Transfer e-codes use employee count instead of allocator
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Allocate via the canonical locked company sequence within the approved transfer transaction; use an external-identity mapping and concurrent transfer tests.

reviewed_findings.title: Future transfers mutate today and promotions do not change salary
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Publish effective-dated placement/salary changes; activate projections on effective date with validated aligned links, historical scope snapshots and signed leave/entity payroll continuity.

reviewed_findings.title: Year-end claim taxable recovery counts unrelated bills repeatedly
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Query each approved taxable bucket/FY and verified line amount exactly once; distinguish unclaimed from unsubstantiated policy and post one idempotent final-FY tax adjustment.

reviewed_findings.title: Parallel-run gate can pass with missing population or component errors
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Compare the union of both employee/component populations, reject empty/mismatched inputs, and require approved tolerances, explained dispositions and persisted two-cycle human sign-offs.

reviewed_findings.title: Opening YTD financial facts exist only in process memory
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Persist immutable reviewed imports/mappings/opening postings with source checksum, employee/FY validation and replay keys; feed the exact facts into payroll snapshots.

reviewed_findings.title: Output readiness and artifact ownership are inferred incorrectly
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Persist versioned per-run/payer artifacts with checksum, complete population and actual generation receipts; expose availability from those records, not approval state.

reviewed_findings.title: SAP mapping loses legal payer and cost-center dimensions
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Use the approved scoped GL mapping keys from the canonical table, fail missing/ambiguous mappings and reconcile exact balanced amounts from frozen placement/result versions.

reviewed_findings.title: Income-tax seed contradicts its cited reference and FY claim

reviewed_findings.required_repair: Resolve D01 with signed authoritative notification/FY evidence; keep one effective-dated statutory policy source shared by real payroll and previews, with independent goldens and explicit unsupported-FY failures.

reviewed_findings.required_repair: Resolve D01 with signed authoritative notification/FY evidence; keep one effective-dated statutory policy source shared by real payroll and previews, with independent goldens and explicit unsupported-FY failures.

reviewed_findings.title: Numeric SOW citations in phase plans and backend comments do not identify the original requirements
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Regenerate phase tables from the exact original crosswalk, preserve requirement IDs, and replace unverified numeric references in backend comments. sow_rows.section: 5.4 Pro rating Salary / Calculation of Arrears:
sow_rows.original_item: Mid-month new joiner
sow_rows.baseline_implemented_evidence: Proration/retro methods are specified; only generic money rounding utilities exist.
sow_rows.baseline_remaining_scope: Implement row-specific join/leave/LOP/reversal/divisor/legacy arrear behavior using signed settings and hand-computed payroll fixtures.

reviewed_findings.title: Payroll attendance SQL is incompatible and day arithmetic is unsafe
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Use work_date plus paid leave/weekoff predicates, SUM weighted days, require complete locked inputs and retain true zero payable days. Integration-test P/HD/LWP/paid-WO/all-absent cases.

reviewed_findings.title: Mid-month salary assignments can be skipped silently
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Resolve approved effective salary segments through the covered period and derive payable tenure from joining/leaving dates. Fail an incomplete run with explicit missing-salary exceptions.

reviewed_findings.title: Recovery inputs print but do not reduce net pay
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Classify input and arrear effects by component kind, validate allowed amounts and update earning/deduction/employer bases consistently. Add an independent full-run recovery fixture.

reviewed_findings.title: Detected OT is paid without approval and uses an absent component
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Consume only approved unconsumed OT against locked inputs; prohibit CO double consumption and bind the approved canonical component/policy base.

reviewed_findings.title: Arrears can be paid again on subsequent runs
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Reserve/consume each signed delta exactly once in the same financial transaction; preserve original/result versions and retry-safe keys.

reviewed_findings.title: Finalization ignores line and review reconciliation failures
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Independently reconcile signed component classes, per-item and full-register totals, expected population and approved review exceptions; require the complete reconciled gate under a transaction/row lock.

reviewed_findings.title: Closed payroll results remain editable
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Protect insert/update/delete of all frozen facts/results using DB constraints/triggers and grants. Retro creates new versions and current-period deltas; preserve original closed results.

reviewed_findings.title: Future transfers mutate today and promotions do not change salary
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Publish effective-dated placement/salary changes; activate projections on effective date with validated aligned links, historical scope snapshots and signed leave/entity payroll continuity.

reviewed_findings.title: Parallel-run gate can pass with missing population or component errors
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Compare the union of both employee/component populations, reject empty/mismatched inputs, and require approved tolerances, explained dispositions and persisted two-cycle human sign-offs.

reviewed_findings.title: Apply-increment reports success without salary revisions
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Resolve approved employee salary facts server-side, atomically create real effective revisions and replay-safe recompute/delta obligations, and return actual persisted counts.

reviewed_findings.title: Salary assignment and payroll disagree on paise versus rupee units
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Use an explicit integer-paise salary snapshot boundary everywhere; inspect existing snapshots for import provenance without guessing their unit. Correct F&F consumers and prove assignment-to-run and assignment-to-F&F integration. Run boundary fixed with regression; remaining consumers and legacy-data provenance remain open.

reviewed_findings.title: Configured PT slabs are accepted by the compute interface but never used
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
repair_evidence: Compute input declaration and computePt call; statutory/pt.ts uses built-in WB table only
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Pass authoritative effective-dated slab facts to the shared PT engine, reject missing applicable state policy, and test custom configured slabs through the run path. Do not infer current statutory rates from this defect review.

reviewed_findings.title: Parallel comparison drops repeated lines of the same component
reviewed_findings.mapping_basis: Exact requirement intersection after expanding original shorthand
reviewed_findings.required_repair: Sum all signed component facts in integer paise per employee/component. Corrected shared component aggregation is now used by the real comparison; durable complete-population two-cycle/sign-off gates remain open under R29.

findings.title: Fresh migration chain cannot build claims schema
findings.problem: The earlier payroll migration creates a claim table without budget_id/reference; this later migration assumes both exist. Existing hrms masks the missing historical budget migration. Fresh up failed at budget_id on disposable PostgreSQL17; native14 separately fails on NULLS syntax.
findings.required_repair: Recover original migration sources, reconcile canonical claims/budgets through forward alterations, then prove empty up, no-op up, down/up and upgrade. Rehearse exact target16.

repair.title: Fresh migration chain cannot build claims schema
repair.remaining: Fresh49 up/no-op/down/up and upgrade of disposable existing-data clone pass on PG16.15/Node24. Original hrms schema not migrated. Forward-only compatibility rollback retains added columns on one-step down.

findings.title: Applied schema and typed checkout still disagree
findings.problem: Local catalog has 132 business relations and 48 applied migrations; 13 applied migration sources are absent. Database interface covers92 relations, leaving40 untyped. pay.gl_accounts declares cost_center_id and gl_description that do not exist physically; actual ownership uses company_code/plant_code/cost_center_code. IF NOT EXISTS does not reconcile a different existing definition.
findings.required_repair: Recover and hash migration provenance; reconcile actual table contracts before feature work. Update Kysely types and migrations together, without dropping canonical models. Untyped deferred modules need explicit scope decisions.

repair.title: Applied schema and typed checkout still disagree
repair.remaining: All132 relation/column names aligned;154 timestamp wrappers corrected; claim_type_id nullable corrected. Deep CHECK-domain/enum compatibility and deferred-feature acceptance remain open.

findings.title: Payroll attendance SQL is incompatible and day arithmetic is unsafe
findings.problem: Actual column is work_date; paid_wo/paid_l are not enum statuses. Read-only EXPLAIN reproduced both errors. COUNT(CASE ... HD THEN0.5) counts HD as1 (P+HD became2 instead of1.5). Zero payable attendance keeps the initialized full month, so correcting SQL alone still overpays wholly absent employees.
findings.required_repair: Use work_date plus paid leave/weekoff predicates, SUM weighted days, require complete locked inputs and retain true zero payable days. Integration-test P/HD/LWP/paid-WO/all-absent cases.

repair.title: Payroll attendance SQL is incompatible and day arithmetic is unsafe
repair.remaining: Real locked attendance query fixes enum/date errors, half-days, paid leave/weekoffs, completeness and zero payable days. Full run policy integration remains open.

findings.title: Mid-month salary assignments can be skipped silently
findings.problem: Salary lookup uses first of month; a new joiner or first assignment effective later that month has no matching row and is silently skipped. emp.doj is loaded but never used to produce the required partial-month pay.
findings.required_repair: Resolve approved effective salary segments through the covered period and derive payable tenure from joining/leaving dates. Fail an incomplete run with explicit missing-salary exceptions.

repair.title: Mid-month salary assignments can be skipped silently
repair.remaining: Includes overlap tenure and mid-month first assignment; missing/empty/gapped/multiple salary segments fail closed. Multiple-revision segment computation remains open.

findings.title: Real payroll never supplies required statutory and debt facts
findings.problem: The production orchestration supplies salary/days/inputs/arrears/hold only. It does not load approved effective PF policy, employee applicability/category/contract, ESIC period membership, TDS projection, LWF or loan installments. The engine defaults PF ceiling, TDS/LWF0 and current-gross ESIC; standalone statutory helpers passing tests do not fix the run.
